summary: Transformed-vector computation: each output component at a1[0..2] is a three-term sum of products between nine matrix-style elements of a3 and the three input components of a2, where the i-th output component is a3[i]*a2[0] + a3[i+4]*a2[1] + a3[i+8]*a2[2]. Writes the three results into a1 and returns the output pointer a1.

operations.description: First output component: v4 = a3[8] * a2[2] + a3[4] * a2[1] + a3[0] * a2[0].
Second output component: v5 = a3[9] * a2[2] + a3[5] * a2[1] + a3[1] * a2[0].
Third output component: v6 = a3[10] * a2[2] + a3[6] * a2[1] + a3[2] * a2[0].
Write the first output component into *a1.
Write the second output component into a1[1].
Write the third output component into a1[2].
Return the output vector pointer a1.

this+0x0/0x4/0x8 are the three written output floats; a3 elements beyond those offsets are parameter-array accesses, not proven object fields.
